datasets.purpose: Acute Food Insecurity Classifications data in different scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators conducted regular (typically monthly) surveys across Zambia to classify acute food insecurity conditions in different scenarios. The resulting classifications were aggregated by administrative area and reporting date to produce a time-series dataset of food insecurity impact assessments for 2011.
